title: Setup rewind of the generator
statement: Let $c,C,q$ be natural numbers, let $x$ be a Boolean input word, and let $j\le q$. Starting in the setup state with every work head at position $j-1$ and empty output, after exactly $j+1$ steps the machine is in the outermost loop state, with every work head at position $0$ and the output empty.
replaced:
From the generator's setup state with all work heads at displacement $j-1$,
for any $j \le q$, exactly $j+1$ steps move all heads to displacement $0$ in
lockstep and enter the outermost loop state, with empty output throughout.
